historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps this row scoped to approved OFED/MFT driver installation and read-only device/firmware inspection unless flash is separately authorized.

original_test_intent: Install the approved MLNX_OFED driver stack for the target Ubuntu/kernel/NIC configuration, reboot once if required, and verify every intended Mellanox/NVIDIA device is present and correctly bound without install or health errors.
original_method: Validate and mount the supplied vendor image, execute the approved tracked driver installer under a maintenance plan, reboot through OOB control, and collect complete per-device module, driver, MST, link and fabric evidence.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies and approves the signed package, compatibility, install options, outage/reboot and rollback; recovery owner maintains OOB while the agent performs only the approved tracked install and verification.
required_inputs: Signed MLNX_OFED/MFT ISO or package, version, checksum, license and vendor documentation
Exact Ubuntu release, kernel, secure-boot state and every target NIC PCI/PSID/firmware compatibility
Approved dependencies, install options and whether --force is necessary
Expected driver/module/MST/device/link/IB versions and acceptance matrix
Maintenance window, outage/reboot approval, independent OOB/console, backup/rollback image and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Verify package signature/checksum and vendor compatibility before mounting or installing
Inventory all devices and current drivers/modules/routes/fabric state; never choose the first matching interface
Require independent recovery before replacing modules that may carry management traffic
Do not pipe yes to a force install, reboot, flash firmware, roll back or retry without explicit authorization
Stop on unsupported platform, build/DKMS/signing failure, link/fabric loss, kernel error or failed boot
agent_execution_scope: Collect host, kernel, secure-boot, NIC, driver, firmware, route and fabric baseline
Validate the approved package and execute only the exact tracked vendor-supported install command
Perform one approved reboot and collect complete per-device post-state and health evidence
Do not infer firmware-flash scope, select arbitrary devices, suppress prompts blindly, recover automatically or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve package/support matrix, installer options and driver-versus-firmware scope
Approve outage, reboot, rollback and recovery ownership
Review full install and per-device health evidence and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe and incomplete: it conflates install with flash, bypasses host-key checking, selects one interface by enumeration order and truncates firmware output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Mount the verified image read-only, run the exact vendor-approved MLNX_OFED installer with a complete log, reboot once under OOB control, then query every mapped device through PCI, module, MST, ethtool and IB tools.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The named MLNX_OFED 5.8 Ubuntu 22.04 example, /tmp/mst staging, install, reboot, MST discovery and 30/30 timing fields are preserved pending compatibility approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed, platform-matched change package and a controlled install/reboot record that proves all target devices bind and recover without granting implicit firmware-flash authority.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces blind yes/force and one-device truncated checks with explicit options, provenance, full device inventory, health evidence and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Driver installation and MST visibility remain mandatory; firmware version is observational unless the separate flash case is authorized.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OFED may replace inbox modules across multiple Ethernet/InfiniBand ports, interact with DKMS and secure boot, and interrupt every interface sharing the stack.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe must select the supported OFED branch and exact device set; a generic ISO filename or successful installer exit alone is insufficient.
expected_evidence: Approval, maintenance record and recovery owner
Complete mount, dependency, install, build and DKMS log with exit/reboot status
Post-boot module/package state and complete per-device PCI/MST/ethtool/IB evidence
Network/fabric/BMC health, non-target comparison, rollback readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master clearly describes driver installation and MST discovery; DeepSeek's flash wording is an unsafe interpretation, not authority to expand the original test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits project package, compatibility and recovery inputs, but the static review is complete and review can continue.

review_improvement: Preserves the MLNX driver-install objective while preventing implicit firmware flashing, blind force installation and incomplete single-interface evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: MLNX_OFED installation can replace kernel modules shared by all Mellanox Ethernet and InfiniBand devices, so installer success and one ethtool query do not prove system recovery. Each PCI function must be mapped to its expected driver and fabric state after a controlled boot, while firmware mutation remains outside this row's authority.
